name: Suzuna Takano
source:
A third year student at Hamasaki High School, Takano is a member of the swimming club and a classmate of Kens. She was born in Russia and has a kind and affectionate, but blunt nature. She is especially popular amongst underclassmen. However, she has a cold attitude towards men for some reason.

[Taken From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_2nd]Wikipedia[/url].]
